title: Add the showDeleteLocalAccountFlow tests settings_utils_test.dart's docstring claims already exist

evidence.quote: //   A1. showDeleteLocalAccountFlow: non-localBorn auth state → exits immediately / //   A2. showDeleteLocalAccountFlow: localBorn → delete dialog shown
// Build the inner dialog widget directly (same builder used / inside showSignOutConfirmation) rather than calling the full

why: Running the file (`flutter test settings_utils_test.dart`) shows exactly 11 tests (S1-S11); A1/A2 don't exist. `grep -rn showDeleteLocalAccountFlow test/` across the whole repo returns zero hits outside this docstring, and account_actions_test.dart (which the comment says 'does not cover' this) also has none. showDeleteLocalAccountFlow is the irreversible local-account-deletion path (closes the Drift handle, deletes the account DB file, clears the device-registry row and session) called from 3 lib sites including the HOTSPOT account_actions.dart; it ships with zero regression coverage while a comment implies it's covered.
recommendation: Write A1 (non-localBorn auth state returns without showing any dialog) and A2 (localBorn auth state shows the delete-confirmation dialog and, once confirmed, drives the delete-local-account path) using the same DB/registry fakes account_management_service_test.dart already has, or delete the stale docstring lines if coverage is intentionally deferred and track it as a real ticket instead.
acceptance_criteria: test/features/settings/settings_utils_test.dart (or a relocated file, see AG-5 finding) contains passing A1 and A2 tests exercising showDeleteLocalAccountFlow directly.
grep -rn 'showDeleteLocalAccountFlow' test/ matches at least one real test body, not just a comment.

corrections: 'Called from 3 lib sites including the HOTSPOT account_actions.dart' is wrong - account_actions.dart:502 is the definition, not a call site. Actual call sites are 2 (parent_settings_screen.dart:356, account_actions_sheet.dart:267); a 4th hit (account_picker_screen.dart:810) is just a comment. Doesn't undermine the core finding, which stands on the missing-test evidence alone.

mergedFrom: Rewrite sign_out_dialog_l10n_test.dart to exercise the real showSignOutConfirmation, not a hand-copied dialog
